body: External research (2026-09-23), editor robustness and text wrapping beside photos. Facts only, no recommendation. Full cited report was returned to the parent.U+000AU+000AU+002D Flutter: #82595 is open (P3) but its subject is narrower than assumed: a TextField inside a WidgetSpan can't line-break. It is not about text flowing around images. dart:ui ParagraphConstraints: "The only constraint that can be specified is the width." No exclusion-zone, per-line-width or float API in the 3.44.0 (2026-05-18) or 3.47.0 (2026-08-12) release notes. Current stable is 3.47.5 (2026-09-18). Third-party packages float_column 4.1.3 and pretext_flutter 0.0.1 are display-only.U+000AU+002D DeltaTextInputClient: available since 2021-09 (framework) with macOS fixes in 2022. Open macOS P2 delta/IME bugs: #153065 (Japanese suggestion panel), #153895 (accent panel). 44 open P2 / 0 P1 issues labelled platform-macos + text input. UndoManager engine plugin exists on iOS only. #90063 (large TextField hangs) is open at P2.U+000AU+002D Editors:U+000A  U+002D super_editor: still no 0.3.x stable (0.3.0-dev.52, 2026-06-11).U+000A  U+002D appflowy_editor 6.2.0: fails to compile on Flutter 3.44 (#1204). Fixed on main 2026-07-27, not released.U+000A  U+002D flutter_quill 11.6.0 (2026-09-16): requires Flutter >=3.44.U+000A  U+002D fleather 1.28.0 (2026-08-24): targets Flutter 3.47.U+000A  U+002D None of the four supports floated images with text wrap while editing. Markdown image round-trip is lossy in appflowy (URL only), fleather (block embeds dropped) and markdown_quill (alt text dropped).U+000A  U+002D New: livemd_flutter 0.6.0 (first published 2026-08-27) uses the same single-TextField + buildTextSpan + WidgetSpan architecture; its GitHub repo returns 404.U+000AU+002D Reference editors: Obsidian (CM6) wraps text beside images only via CSS snippets, which broke in Live Preview in 1.12.4/1.12.7. Typora wraps only via inline HTML float. Word does it natively (anchored floats, wrap square). No Markdown editor checked offers it natively.U+000AU+002D Latency: Fatin 2015 (~26 ms I/O baseline, aim 1-5 ms editor processing); Luu 2017 (perception down to 2 ms). Flutter docs: build 8 ms + raster 8 ms at 60 Hz, under 8 ms total at 120 Hz. macOS display-link delay open as #190385 (P2).U+000AU+000AStill open: whether super_editor dev.52 and fleather 1.28 build on Flutter 3.44 (not tested); whether any editor round-trips Markdown byte-for-byte; Bear, iA Writer, Notion and Apple Notes wrap behaviour is undocumented.
